Focused UI verification on 1920x1080 confirms the Agenda create/edit event modal is fully visible (create/edit top=54, bottom=1026), the TITRE field is visible above CATÉGORIE (title_top=175, category_top=239), and the title can be edited and persisted through create/update/delete. critical_code_review_comments: Verified Management.jsx EventEditor, EntryEditor, WeekEditor, Requests info modal, and SlideEditor render via PortalModal/createPortal(document.body); Actualites.jsx PostEditor also renders via createPortal(document.body).
index.css ms-fade-up final keyframe now uses transform: none, which is a defensive mitigation for fixed-position containing block issues.
seed_data_creation: Temporary event 'QA Modal Layout Test 2026' was created, edited to 'QA Modal Layout Test 2026 Edited', then deleted via the UI; no persistent seed data should remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Focused browser automation passed on preview URL with admin credentials. Key evidence: agenda EventEditor create/edit top=54 bottom=1026 on 1080px viewport; event-title top=175 and editable. Other portalized modals top>=0. No relevant testing skill found.
rca_of_the_issue: The prior symptom was consistent with fixed-position dialogs being captured by an ancestor transform on .ms-fade-up. The tested fix portals dialogs to document.body and removes the final transform from the fade-up animation; the user-visible Agenda title field is now visible and editable.
